question:
Which of the following is a report published by Reserve Bank of India?

I. Financial Stability Report

II. Handbook of Statistics on Indian Economy
solution: The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** publishes various reports to provide insights into the **financial system, economy, and macroeconomic conditions** in India. • The **Financial Stability Report (FSR)** is a biannual publication by the RBI. It focuses on the stability and resilience of the Indian financial system and provides insights into systemic risks. *Hence, statement I is correct.* • The **Handbook of Statistics on Indian Economy** is another critical publication by the RBI. It serves as a comprehensive source of statistical data on various economic indicators, including banking, financial markets, and external sector statistics. *Hence, statement II is correct.* • Both these reports are **key publications by the Reserve Bank of India** and are widely used by policymakers, analysts, and researchers to assess the economic and financial environment in India. • ***Hence, the correct answer is Both I and II.***
